corrections.reason: The page image clearly shows 'አምሳሊሁ' (beginning with አ and having the 3rd order ሊ with bottom right leg, not 5th order ሌ), matching the canonical Ge'ez Gospel phrasing (Matt 24:32).
The verb agrees with the feminine plural subject 'እልክቱ [አንስት]' (matching 'ወሖራ'), and the 4th order 'ኣ' with shortened left leg is visible in 'ወወጽኣ' (Matt 28:8).
